fields.label: Collision model: Origin point
fields.description: Compile the single-point collision model.

fields.label: Collision model: Triangle
fields.description: Compile the triangle collision model.

fields.label: Collision model: Bounding box
fields.description: Compile the bounding-box collision model.

fields.label: Enable slope collision
fields.description: Enable slope collision

fields.label: Max behavior slots
fields.description: Number of behavior definition slots available (each slot uses 8 bytes of RAM)

fields.label: Max moving platforms
fields.description: Number of 'Moving platform' actors that can claim/release riders per scene (each uses 11 bytes of RAM). Platforms beyond this limit still move but never pick up riders. Requires the parent actors component.

fields.label: Component: Gravity
fields.description: Compile the gravity component. Uncheck to save ROM if no behavior uses gravity.

fields.label: Topdown Z axis
fields.description: Enable actor Z position/velocity fields and apply gravity to Z instead of Y (topdown jump/height simulation).

fields.label: Component: Move horizontally
fields.description: Compile horizontal movement and wall collision. Uncheck to save ROM if no behavior moves horizontally.

fields.label: Component: Move vertically
fields.description: Compile vertical movement and floor/ceiling collision. Required for gravity to have a visible effect.

fields.label: Component: Turn at ledges
fields.description: Compile smart ledge detection. Requires 'Move horizontally'.

fields.label: Component: Turn at walls
fields.description: Compile velocity reversal on wall hits. When disabled, actors stop at walls instead.

fields.label: Component: Bounce on floor/ceiling
fields.description: Compile bounce physics (includes 32-bit math). When disabled, actors stop on floor/ceiling instead. Requires 'Move vertically'.

fields.label: Component: Parent actors / moving platforms
fields.description: Compile parent actor inheritance: any actor with a parent set follows the parent's per-frame movement and still runs its own behavior physics. Also compiles the 'Moving platform' behavior component, which automatically parents/unparents the actors it touches. Uncheck to save ROM if nothing uses parenting or platforms.

fields.label: Parenting mode
fields.description: How a parented actor follows its parent. Static: the actor is pinned at a fixed pixel offset (its own X/Y velocity) from the parent and runs no other behavior code - fastest. Inherit first parent velocity: the actor is carried by its direct parent's velocity (tile-collision checked) and still runs its own behavior - only tracks parents that have a dynamic velocity. Apply all parents positions delta: the actor is displaced by the summed position change of its whole parent chain (tile-collision checked) and still runs its own behavior - follows any parent including engine-moved ones like the player, slowest.

fields.label: Platforms attach the player only
fields.description: When checked, a 'Moving platform' actor only auto-attaches the player when it touches it - other actors are ignored (they can still be parented explicitly with Set Actor Parent Actor). When unchecked, a platform attaches every actor it touches (subject to its collision group). Checking this also saves the per-frame claim test on every non-player actor.

fields.label: Component: Collide with other actors
fields.description: Compile actor-vs-actor collision (blocks/turns on contact with other collidable actors; the player is already handled by the engine). Uncheck to save ROM if no behavior uses it.

fields.label: Component: Trigger other actors' On Hit
fields.description: Compile the 'trigger other actors On Hit on collision' behavior option: an actor with it set runs the On Hit script of every collidable actor it overlaps (the engine normally does this only for the player). Uncheck to save ROM if no behavior uses it.

fields.label: Component: Actors activate triggers
fields.description: Compile the 'activate triggers on enter/leave' behavior option: an actor with it set fires trigger On Enter / On Leave scripts as it moves in and out of triggers (the engine normally does this only for the player). Uses one byte of RAM per actor to track each actor's current trigger. Uncheck to save ROM/RAM if no behavior uses it.

fields.label: Component: Animation handling
fields.description: Compile automatic animation (face direction, idle, jump). Uncheck if you handle animations yourself.

fields.label: VM: Wait for collision
fields.description: Compile vm_wait_for_collision waitable helper.

fields.label: VM motion: Chase actor
fields.description: Compile vm_actor_chase_actor.

fields.label: VM motion: Move to position by velocity
fields.description: Compile vm_actor_move_to_pos_by_velocity.

fields.label: VM motion: Crawl step
fields.description: Compile vm_actor_crawl_step.
